# Live In Oakridge

> Justin Skrypnyk is a licensed Real Estate Broker with Sutton Group Chapman Realty Inc., Brokerage, specializing in Oakridge, West London, and Whitehills in London, Ontario. Contact: 519.639.5176 | info@homeswithjustin.ca | https://www.liveinoakridge.ca

Justin Skrypnyk helps buyers and sellers navigate the West London Ontario real estate market. A third-generation Oakridge resident — his family has called the neighbourhood home since 1959 — he brings hyper-local expertise, professional marketing, and honest advice to every transaction. Services include buying, selling, complimentary home evaluations, first-time buyer guidance, downsizing, upsizing, relocation, and investment properties.

## Key Facts

- Licensed Real Estate Broker in Ontario, Canada
- REALTOR®, member of the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA)
- Brokerage: Sutton Group Chapman Realty Inc., Brokerage
- Third-generation Oakridge resident — family in the neighbourhood since 1959
- Primary market: Oakridge, West London, and Whitehills, with Byron, Westmount, Riverbend, and Lambeth also served
- Phone: 519.639.5176
- Email: info@homeswithjustin.ca
- Google reviews: see https://share.google/swwXpwTpwjv6x4eYg for current rating and review count

## Neighbourhood Pages

- [West London](/areas/west-london/) — Established, convenient, value-driven neighbourhood in the heart of the west end, avg. $520K–$720K
- [Whitehills, London Ontario](/areas/whitehills/) — Northwest London family community, three schools and five parks, avg. $520K–$720K
- [Byron, London Ontario](/areas/byron/) — Trails, parks, and timeless community in southwest London, avg. $700K–$950K
- [Westmount, London Ontario](/areas/westmount/) — Urban-suburban west London, near Western University, avg. $550K–$750K
- [Riverbend, London Ontario](/areas/riverbend/) — Southwest London's premier new-build, golf-course community, avg. $730K–$900K+
- [Lambeth, London Ontario](/areas/lambeth/) — Suburban calm with small-town character in southwest London, avg. $700K–$1.1M

## Common Questions

**What is the average home price in London Ontario?**
The average home price in London Ontario is approximately $625,000–$660,000 as of mid-2026. West-end communities like Oakridge, Byron, Riverbend, and Lambeth average $650K–$1.1M. More affordable options exist in West London and Whitehills at $520K–$720K.

**How do I get a home evaluation in London Ontario?**
Contact Justin Skrypnyk at 519.639.5176 or visit https://www.liveinoakridge.ca/services/home-evaluation/ to book a complimentary, no-obligation home evaluation.

**What areas does Justin Skrypnyk serve?**
Justin's primary service areas are Oakridge, West London, and Whitehills, with Byron, Westmount, Riverbend, and Lambeth also served.

**How current is the market data on each neighbourhood page?**
Each neighbourhood page publishes live-updated median list price, active listing count, and average days on market, refreshed twice monthly from active MLS® listings across every brokerage. This reflects current asking prices, not closed/sold prices.

**What is the difference between a Real Estate Broker and a REALTOR in Ontario?**
In Ontario, a Real Estate Broker holds an advanced license that requires additional education and experience beyond a salesperson. A REALTOR® is a member of the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA). Justin Skrypnyk is both a licensed Broker and a REALTOR®.
